core_details.description:
Temporary use of Right of Way Permit has been issued for this location. 
 Details: 174 extension from Jul 05, 2026 to Dec 25, 2026
180 extension from Jan 06, 2026 to Jul 04, 2026
180 extension from Jan 11, 2025 to Jul 09, 2025
171 extension from Jul 24, 2024 to Jan 10, 2025
180 extension from Jan 27, 2024 to Jul 24, 2024

**CHECK PERMITS 23-037811 RW AND 23 081408 RW, BEFORE INVOICING THIS ONE** 

**2023-156127 EX will work behind this Long-term closure. **

The Contractor overseeing the work will be JE Dunn Construction. This right-of-way closure will facilitate the work being completed for the Texas Facilities Commission Capitol Complex Expansion Project (Phase 2). 

This closure will require 2 Colorado St. Traffic Lanes (lane 1) 10 X 301 and (lane 2) 10 X 301. 

This closure does not interfere with any city-owned metered parking. JE Dunn Construction will be the CMR managing all work being done within this closure. All work within this closure is being completed on The State of Texas property. See attached engineered traffic control plan.
core_details.name: JE Dunn Construction - Colorado St Lane Closures- CapComp Phase 2
